content: Build a docs chatbot over our internal architecture markdown files.
I will write a new chunker, embedding wrapper, vector index, retrieval function, citation formatter, and eval script.
I am loading every markdown file into the prompt to decide chunk size.
I will skip citation validation for now and ask the model to include sources.
AIDevObserver found context.chunk_markdown, retrieval.hybrid_search, and citation.validate_spans after the agent wrote a duplicate chunker.
I will keep my chunker because it is simple.
AIDevObserver should catch RAG primitive reinvention, excessive context loading, missing citation gate, and missed evaluation template.
